integrity: Underlying individual-hull radial-distribution theorem is explicitly credited to Kabluchko; finite deterministic computational checks are supporting evidence, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Expected area and a fixed-direction radial law only, for standard independent isotropic planar Brownian motions and bridges. The joint population crossover assumes a finite limiting proportion. Independent validation and exhaustive historical-priority assessment are not performed.
title: Sharp area-collapse and mixed-population crossover for intersections of planar Brownian hulls
